newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 92-day bills average accepted yield 4.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 92-day bills average accepted yield 4.90 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 92-day Exchange Fund bills was 4.90 percent at a tender on Tuesday, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compared with the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate of 5.70455 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.77 percent at last week's tender of the quarterly bills.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue were HK$6.93 billion against HK$6.37 billion at last week's tender.
